name: pokemon-auto-lister
description: Personal Windows Pokémon auto-lister: phone/LAN dashboard upload, PokeGrade + TCGPlayer + eBay solds pricing, Mercari Playwright and eBay Sell API drafts only (never publish).
goals: Upload card photos from phone on LAN; pick front image; enqueue for processing
Identify/price via PokeGrade /value; cross-check TCGPlayer market and eBay last~5 solds
Auto-create Mercari and/or eBay drafts when sources agree within 15%; else Needs review
Survive reboots via Windows Task Scheduler; persist queue/state as JSON/CSV
nonGoals: Public tunnels, Tailscale, multi-tenant, or database server
TCGPlayer sold scrapes or paid third-party sold feeds
technicalNotes: Greenfield Node.js + Playwright (real Chrome channel for Mercari) + static dashboard. State under data/. Secrets in .env. Mercari: channel chrome, headful, persistent profile, AutomationControlled disabled; never auto-login. eBay: official Sell/Inventory draft APIs. Pricing: median of available sources × per-marketplace multiplier (default 1.0 = 0% over market); Needs review if low PokeGrade confidence OR pairwise relative spread >15%. UI reference: docs/autopilot/pokemon-auto-lister/draft-activity-ui-reference.png. Tests: node:test or vitest; no live marketplace calls in CI.
_step_size: One logical change per commit. Quality over speed.

requirements.description: Pricing engine: blend PokeGrade, TCGPlayer market, eBay median solds; multipliers; 15% Needs-review rule

patterns: Pure functions for compare/blend — easy unit tests
